meta.title: 找光是为了看清楚，那影呢？

scenes.context: 布置了半天拍出来还是乱，问题可能不在杂物，而在灯。
sentences: I carefully styled the scene for ages.
为啥拍出来还是乱乱的？
Why does it still look messy in the shot?
It might be because of that.
paraphrase: I set up the scene so carefully, yet it's still a mess.
The culprit might be this one thing.
scenes.speak: I carefully styled the scene for ages. Why does it still look messy in the shot? It might be because of that.

scenes.context: 大灯均匀照亮一切，也让影子消失；换成小灯，画面立刻有氛围。
sentences: Turn off this big overhead lamp.
换成两个更有氛围的小灯。
Replace it with two cozy accent lights.
大灯能均匀地照亮每一样东西。
A big lamp lights everything evenly.
但同时也让影子全部消失。
But it also wipes out every shadow.
paraphrase: Swap it for two softer, moodier lights.
It kills all the shadows at the same time.
scenes.speak: Turn off this big overhead lamp. Replace it with two cozy accent lights. That's much better already. A big lamp lights everything evenly. But it also wipes out every shadow.

scenes.context: 用影去吞没多余的细节，有光的地方才格外突出。
sentences: 需要用影去吞没多余的细节。
You need shadow to swallow the extra details.
那些有光的地方才会格外突出。
Only then do the lit areas stand out.
不是因为环境乱，而是因为光太匀。
It's not the messy space, but the too-even light.
paraphrase: Let darkness bury the unnecessary details.
Nothing stands out because there's no contrast.
scenes.speak: You need shadow to swallow the extra details. Only then do the lit areas stand out. It's not the messy space, but the too-even light. That's why it lacks hierarchy.

scenes.context: 电影场景看似打乱却耐看；修图时也能通过重塑光影拯救废片。
sentences: 很多电影场景看似打乱，却一点也不显脏。
Many movie scenes look cluttered yet never dirty.
手机里的废片也可以被拯救。
Those rejected photos on your phone can be saved too.
干脆把不要的细节涂成纯黑色。
Just paint the unwanted details pure black.
paraphrase: They're oddly enjoyable to keep looking at.
The throwaway shots in your camera roll can be rescued.
scenes.speak: Many movie scenes look cluttered yet never dirty. They're actually pleasing to watch. Those rejected photos on your phone can be saved too. Just paint the unwanted details pure black.

practice: I carefully styled the scene for ages.
大灯能均匀地照亮每一样东西。
A big lamp lights everything evenly.
需要用影去吞没多余的细节。
You need shadow to swallow the extra details.
把不要的细节涂成纯黑色。
Paint the unwanted details pure black.
pitfalls: Because of the light makes it messy.
The messy look comes from the too-even light.
because of 后接名词短语，不接句子
A big lamp light everything evenly.
A big lamp lights everything evenly.
主语第三人称单数，谓语加 s
The lit areas will stand out.
stand out 是动词短语，outstanding 是形容词
paint + 宾语 + 形容词补语，不用 to

让影去吞没细节，主次立现
